study.title: Establishing a Multi-Dimensional Risk Framework over the Full Lifecycle of Stablecoins
study.author: Xueli Li
future_research: Risk-specific indicator sets and composite measures where appropriate

lifecycle.label: Foundation, Backing & Issuance
lifecycle.meaning: Where backing, legal/technical foundations and issuance arrangements are established.
lifecycle.representative_risks: C5 — Asset-Liability Maturity Mismatch; C14 — Lack of Bankruptcy Remoteness for Reserves

lifecycle.label: Circulation, Trading & Settlement
lifecycle.meaning: Where tokens circulate, trade and settle without necessarily becoming embedded in layered financial positions.
lifecycle.representative_risks: C22 — Deficient Secondary Market Order Book Depth; U1 — Underlying Public Blockchain Network Congestion

lifecycle.label: Protocol Embedding & Layered Finance
lifecycle.meaning: Where stablecoins become collateral, liquidity positions or other embedded financial positions inside protocols.
lifecycle.representative_risks: U18 — DeFi Nested Collateralization Risks; U24 — Excessive Credit Expansion via AMO Algorithms

lifecycle.label: Redemption, Deleveraging & Liquidation
lifecycle.meaning: Where positions exit, redeem, deleverage or liquidate.
lifecycle.representative_risks: C26 — Asymmetric Redemption Channels; U25 — Unbuffered Cascading Liquidations

amplification.label: Initial Trigger
amplification.meaning: A shock that directly initiates the risk episode.
amplification.representative_risks_or_outcomes: C1 — Macro Interest Rate Shocks; U2 — Layer 2 Sequencer Downtime

amplification.label: Structural Vulnerability
amplification.meaning: A pre-existing weakness that shapes susceptibility to shocks.
amplification.representative_risks_or_outcomes: C5 — Asset-Liability Maturity Mismatch; C22 — Deficient Secondary Market Order Book Depth

amplification.label: Dynamic Amplification
amplification.meaning: Activated reactions or feedback loops that magnify an initial shock.
amplification.representative_risks_or_outcomes: U21 — High Friction Inducing Arbitrage Failure; U25 — Unbuffered Cascading Liquidations

amplification.label: Cross-System Transmission / Outcomes
amplification.meaning: Effects that propagate beyond the focal stablecoin into other stablecoins, DeFi, broader crypto or traditional financial markets.
amplification.representative_risks_or_outcomes: Other stablecoins; DeFi protocols; broader crypto markets; traditional financial markets

modules.name: Backing Assets & Balance Sheet
modules.representative_risks: C5 — Asset-Liability Maturity Mismatch; C10 — Insufficient Reserve Market Capacity

modules.name: Issuer Transparency, Legal Structure & Custody
modules.representative_risks: C11 — Balance Sheet Transparency Time-Lag; C16 — Custodian Credit Default

modules.name: Fiat Settlement, Regulation & Redemption
modules.representative_risks: C17 — Fiat Clearing Temporal Mismatch; C26 — Asymmetric Redemption Channels

modules.name: Secondary Markets, Token Holders & Confidence
modules.representative_risks: C22 — Deficient Secondary Market Order Book Depth; C25 — Erosion of the Credit Foundation

modules.name: Technical Infrastructure, Code, Cryptography & Information
modules.representative_risks: U1 — Underlying Public Blockchain Network Congestion; U8 — Smart Contract Vulnerabilities

modules.name: Governance & Privileged Control
modules.representative_risks: C13 — Highly Centralized Governance Permissions; U15 — DAO Governance Proposal Manipulation

modules.name: DeFi Integration, On-Chain Markets & Endogenous Mechanisms
modules.representative_risks: U18 — DeFi Nested Collateralization Risks; U25 — Unbuffered Cascading Liquidations

future.description: Translate atomic risks into pre-specified measurement designs with dedicated indicators.
Develop composite measures only where conceptually justified.
Estimate directional transmission and dynamic amplification across quantified risk units and market states.
Develop time-varying monitoring, stress detection and tiered early-warning tools.
Map major regulatory regimes against the submitted atomic-risk framework.
Measure regulatory coverage gaps across risk dimensions and lifecycle locations.
Develop targeted recommendations for regulatory framework improvement.
